# Sudoku Unlimited

> Free online Sudoku puzzles from Easy to Extreme, plus Daily Challenge, Killer Sudoku, printable sheets, kids grids, and a Sudoku Solver. No signup or download.

## Play

- [Home](https://sudokuunlimited.com/): Play free Sudoku online
- [Easy](https://sudokuunlimited.com/easy): Easy Sudoku
- [Medium](https://sudokuunlimited.com/medium): Medium Sudoku
- [Hard](https://sudokuunlimited.com/hard): Hard Sudoku
- [Expert](https://sudokuunlimited.com/expert): Expert Sudoku
- [Master](https://sudokuunlimited.com/master): Master Sudoku
- [Extreme](https://sudokuunlimited.com/extreme): Extreme Sudoku
- [Daily Challenge](https://sudokuunlimited.com/daily): One shared puzzle per UTC day
- [Sudoku Solver](https://sudokuunlimited.com/sudoku-solver): Check or complete a grid
- [Killer Sudoku](https://sudokuunlimited.com/killer-sudoku): Rules, cages, and links to every Killer difficulty

## Print

- [Printable Sudoku](https://sudokuunlimited.com/printable): Free puzzle sheets with a solution page
- [Printable Easy](https://sudokuunlimited.com/printable/easy): Four easy puzzles and solutions
- [Printable Medium](https://sudokuunlimited.com/printable/medium): Four medium puzzles and solutions
- [Printable Hard](https://sudokuunlimited.com/printable/hard): Four hard puzzles and solutions
- [Printable Expert](https://sudokuunlimited.com/printable/expert): Four expert puzzles and solutions

## Kids

- [Kids Sudoku](https://sudokuunlimited.com/kids-sudoku): 4×4 and 6×6 rules for kids and parents
- [4×4 Sudoku](https://sudokuunlimited.com/kids-sudoku/4x4): Playable 4×4 grid with a printable option
- [6×6 Sudoku](https://sudokuunlimited.com/kids-sudoku/6x6): Playable 6×6 grid with a printable option

## Guides

- [Sudoku Guides](https://sudokuunlimited.com/guides): Rules, approaches, and advanced techniques
- [How Sudoku Works](https://sudokuunlimited.com/guides/the-complete-guide-to-how-sudoku-works): Complete rules and solving guide
- [5 Ways to Approach Number Puzzles](https://sudokuunlimited.com/guides/5-ways-to-approach-number-puzzles-like-sudoku): Practical solving routine for beginners
- [9 Advanced Sudoku Techniques](https://sudokuunlimited.com/guides/9-advanced-sudoku-techniques-that-experienced-solvers-use): Fish, wings, chains, and uniqueness
- [How to Solve Sudoku Without Guessing](https://sudokuunlimited.com/guides/solve-sudoku-without-guessing): Scanning, singles, pairs, fish, and chains in order
- [Naked Singles](https://sudokuunlimited.com/guides/naked-singles): Place a cell that has one candidate
- [Hidden Singles](https://sudokuunlimited.com/guides/hidden-singles): Place a digit that has one home in a unit
- [Naked Pairs](https://sudokuunlimited.com/guides/naked-pairs): Two cells that reserve two digits
- [Hidden Pairs](https://sudokuunlimited.com/guides/hidden-pairs): Two digits confined to two cells
- [Naked Triples](https://sudokuunlimited.com/guides/naked-triples): Three cells that reserve three digits
- [Pointing Pairs](https://sudokuunlimited.com/guides/pointing-pairs): A box digit locked to one line
- [Box-Line Reduction](https://sudokuunlimited.com/guides/box-line-reduction): A line digit claimed by one box
- [X-Wing](https://sudokuunlimited.com/guides/x-wing): A two-row, two-column fish
- [Swordfish](https://sudokuunlimited.com/guides/swordfish): A three-row, three-column fish
- [XY-Wing](https://sudokuunlimited.com/guides/xy-wing): A pivot and two wings that delete one candidate
